---
title: Make it your own
subtitle: The Folio theme, installed the same way as the Tufte theme.
---

## Add the theme

```sh
smalldocs add rahuldave/smalldocs-folio
```

The command installs `_extensions/folio/`, with both modes and local fonts.

## Choose it

In `_smalldocs.yml`:

```yaml
theme: folio
toc: true
code-copy: true
```

For a `_quarto.yml` built by SmallDocs, put `theme: folio` under `smalldocs:`.
The normal SmallDocs navigation control switches between the two color modes.

## With Quarto

```sh
quarto add rahuldave/smalldocs-folio
```

```yaml
format:
  folio-html:
    toc: true
```

## Editable sources

The [repository](https://github.com/rahuldave/smalldocs-folio) contains the full
theme source in `src/`, font files and Bootstrap in `vendor/`, the build scripts,
tests, and these example pages. Run `sh scripts/build.sh` to rebuild the CSS and
Quarto Sass. The compiled files in `_extensions/folio/` are committed too, so
installing the theme needs no CSS compiler.

## The design

Cream paper, forest green, and expressive Caslon. A quieter cousin of the CRBooks catalog.

All code uses IBM Plex Mono, bundled with the theme. The source and examples
have an MIT license; the fonts retain their SIL Open Font License notices.

Folio takes its Caslon headings, cream paper, forest green, and rust accents
from the [CRBooks catalog](https://rahuldave.com/crbooks/).

## Optional title label

The current theme does not add a fixed label above your title. To restore that
effect, create `styles.css` in your site folder and add it to `_smalldocs.yml`:

```yaml
theme: folio
css: styles.css
```

Put this rule in `styles.css`, and change the quoted label to suit your site:

```css
html .quarto-title::before {
  content: "FIELD NOTES / SMALLDOCS";
  display: block;
  font: 500 .6rem var(--bs-font-sans-serif);
  letter-spacing: .16em;
  color: var(--e-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 1.3rem;
}
```

The rule adds the same decorative text above every title. For text that changes
with the page, use its content or `subtitle:` in its front matter. Remove the CSS
rule to turn the label off.

The [theme handbook](https://rahuldave.com/elegant-themes/theme-guide.html#folio) describes
this theme and shows how to connect your stylesheet with SmallDocs and Quarto.
